note: The base layer's own data: schemes that hold across India. The crop library, the inputs book, the cycle rules, storage and support prices of the base are the app's own (packages agro, inputs, region's DefaultRules, prices). Overlays in data/overlays and the -regions folder change them by place.

schemes.note: Crops and areas are notified by each state for each season. A localised loss (hailstorm, landslide, inundation, cloudburst, natural fire) or a post-harvest loss is reported within 72 hours on the Crop Insurance App, the insurer's toll-free number, the bank or the agriculture department.
